item.title: The TikTok Story That Fooled Thousands
item.description: Madison "Maddie" Russo gained widespread support on TikTok after claiming she was battling cancer, inspiring thousands to donate and follow her journey. But an investigation found key parts of her story were fabricated, leading to criminal charges, restitution, and a probation sentence that sparked debate about trust and online fundraising.

item.title: The Conman Who Claimed He Was An Alien Doctor
item.description: Diazien Hossencofft convinced women he was an immortal alien, a brilliant scientist, and a doctor who could cure cancer and stop aging with miracle injections. Behind the lies was a ruthless con artist whose manipulation and bizarre beliefs culminated in the disappearance and murder of his wife, Girly Chew Hossencofft, whose body has never been found.

item.title: The Professor Who Opened Fire On Her Colleagues
item.description: Amy Bishop appeared to have a promising academic career until a faculty meeting at the University of Alabama in Huntsville ended in gunfire. Investigators later uncovered a disturbing history of violence, including the controversial death of her own brother decades earlier, raising questions about how the warning signs were missed for so long.

item.title: Australia’s Most Sadistic Killer
item.description: Daniel James Holdom murdered 20-year-old Karlie Pearce-Stevenson and her two-year-old daughter, Khandalyce, before dumping their bodies more than 1,200 kilometers apart in an attempt to hide his crimes. Investigators later uncovered a trail of deception, disturbing trophy photographs, and horrific details that led to two life sentences for one of Australia's most notorious double murderers.

item.title: The Mother Who Turned Her Home Into A House Of Horror

item.title: A Love Triangle Ended In A Murder For Hire Plot
item.description: Brenda Delgado became the focus of an international manhunt after investigators linked her to a murder-for-hire plot targeting her ex-boyfriend's new girlfriend. The case exposed a calculated plan driven by jealousy and obsession that ended in a devastating tragedy.

item.title: The Daughter Who Helped Kill Her Own Mother
item.description: Gypsy Rose Blanchard spent years under the control of her mother, Dee Dee Blanchard, who investigators say fabricated illnesses and subjected her to prolonged medical abuse. The case took a shocking turn when Dee Dee was found murdered, revealing one of the most disturbing family tragedies in modern true crime.
